name: facebookresearch_balance/balance/weighting_methods/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_balance/balance/weighti.run_adjust_null: run adjust_null to return sample weights unchanged with a null_adjustment method tag
facebookresearch_balance/balance/weighti.create_null_weighting: create a null weighting result that passes through sample weights without any adjustment
facebookresearch_balance/balance/weighti.test_adjust_null: test adjust_null by passing sample and target DataFrames with weights and verify the method is null_adjustment
facebookresearch_balance/balance/weighti.review_adjust_null: review the adjust_null function to understand how it returns unmodified sample weights
facebookresearch_balance/balance/weighti.summarize_adjust_null: summarize the adjust_null function which returns original sample weights with a null_adjustment model tag

facebookresearch_balance/balance/weighti.run_cbps_weighting: fit a covariate balancing propensity score model to compute sample weights that balance covariates against a target population
facebookresearch_balance/balance/weighti.compute_pseudo_weights_from_logit_probs: compute pseudo weights from logit probabilities, design weights, and a target population indicator vector
facebookresearch_balance/balance/weighti.compute_gmm_loss: compute the generalized method of moments loss given beta coefficients, covariates, design weights, and a target indicator
facebookresearch_balance/balance/weighti.compute_balance_loss: compute the covariate balance loss given beta coefficients, covariate matrix, design weights, target indicator, and XtX inverse
facebookresearch_balance/balance/weighti.compute_design_effect: compute the design effect of estimated weights on the sample given beta coefficients and design weights

facebookresearch_balance/balance/weighti.run_ipw_weighting: run inverse propensity weighting to compute adjusted sample weights using a target population
facebookresearch_balance/balance/weighti.run_ipw_with_custom_model: run inverse propensity weighting with a custom sklearn classifier like HistGradientBoostingClassifier
facebookresearch_balance/balance/weighti.extract_model_coefs: extract coefficient values and intercept from a fitted sklearn logistic regression model
facebookresearch_balance/balance/weighti.transform_probabilities_to_log_odds: transform predicted probabilities into log odds using the link function
facebookresearch_balance/balance/weighti.choose_regularization_parameters: choose the best regularization lambda and weight trimming via grid search on ASMD improvement

facebookresearch_balance/balance/weighti.run_poststratify_single_variable: run poststratify on a single categorical variable to adjust sample weights to match target population distribution
facebookresearch_balance/balance/weighti.run_poststratify_joint_distribution: run poststratify on the joint distribution of multiple variables to compute cell-based adjusted weights
facebookresearch_balance/balance/weighti.run_poststratify_with_formula: run poststratify using a formula string like 'a:b:c' to select post-stratification variables instead of a list
facebookresearch_balance/balance/weighti.run_poststratify_with_weight_trimming: run poststratify with weight trimming via mean ratio or percentile to clip extreme weight values
facebookresearch_balance/balance/weighti.run_poststratify_store_metadata: run poststratify with store_fit_metadata enabled to persist fit artifacts for later weight reconstruction

facebookresearch_balance/balance/weighti.run_rake_weighting: run raking on sample and target DataFrames using iterative proportional fitting to compute adjusted survey weights
facebookresearch_balance/balance/weighti.prepare_marginal_dist_for_raking: create a DataFrame from nested dictionaries of marginal proportions for use as raking target data
facebookresearch_balance/balance/weighti.realize_dicts_of_proportions: generate equal-length proportional arrays from dictionaries of category proportions using LCM or Hare-Niemeyer allocation
facebookresearch_balance/balance/weighti.run_ipf_numpy: run iterative proportional fitting on a NumPy array against target marginal distributions with convergence tracking
facebookresearch_balance/balance/weighti.hare_niemeyer_allocation: allocate slots to categories using the Hare-Niemeyer largest remainder method to avoid rounding bias
